name: reading-expert
description: Reading training coach: turns 26 books of methodology (reading, learning science, knowledge management) into executable training plans. Dual routing of symptom diagnosis and reading-material profiling, five-framework engine, scientific training protocols, and text-only sparring so training closes 100% inside the chat.
